question.value: Do hot corino, disk and ejected gas coexist in HH212-MM1, probed by high-excitation CH3CHO and HDO lines?

evidence.quote: we aim to investigate whether and how hot corinos, circumstellar disks, and ejected gas are related in young solar-mass protostars.
This paper makes use of the ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.000647.S data (PI: C. Codella).
HH212 was observed at 850 $\mu$m with ALMA using 24 12 m antennas on 2012 December 1 (Early Science Cycle 0 phase; Codella et al. 2014).
The spectral windows 333.7–337.4 GHz and 345.6–349.3 GHz were observed using spectral units of 488 kHz (0.42–0.44 km s$^{-1}$).
The baselines were between 20 m and 360 m with a maximum unfiltered scale of 3$\ensuremath{''}$.
